_source: Hora (planetary hour) lords follow the Chaldean order Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Sun, Venus, Mercury, Moon (slowest to fastest); the first hora of a Vedic day (from sunrise) belongs to the weekday lord, and BPHS Ch 3 vv. 35-38 counts the hora lord among the time lords (archive.org 'Parashara Hora Sastra' text); the Chaldean sequence itself is the traditional hora order, not a verse checked here. Colours: the base colour is BPHS Ch 3 vv. 16-17 (complexions: Sun blood-red, Moon tawny, Mars blood-red, Mercury the green of grass, Jupiter tawny, Venus variegated, Saturn dark) read with Phaladeepika Ch 2 vv. 8-14 (the Moon white, Jupiter yellow), checked against the cached texts. The extra shades (copper, silver, coral, gold, pastel/pink, dark blue) are later popular usage and are labelled 'traditional association'.
order_ref: traditional (Chaldean) hora order from the weekday lord at sunrise; BPHS Ch 3 vv. 35-38 (hora lord among the time lords)

sun.source: red: BPHS Ch 3 vv. 16-17 (blood-red), Phaladeepika Ch 2 v. 8; copper: traditional association

moon.source: white: Phaladeepika Ch 2 v. 9 (BPHS Ch 3 vv. 16-17 says tawny); silver: traditional association

mars.source: red: BPHS Ch 3 vv. 16-17 (blood-red), Phaladeepika Ch 2 v. 10; coral: traditional association

mercury.source: BPHS Ch 3 vv. 16-17 (green of grass), Phaladeepika Ch 2 v. 11; traditional association for daily wear

jupiter.source: yellow: Phaladeepika Ch 2 v. 12 (BPHS Ch 3 vv. 16-17 says tawny); gold: traditional association

venus.source: BPHS Ch 3 vv. 16-17 and Phaladeepika Ch 2 v. 13 say variegated; white, pastel and pink: traditional association

saturn.source: black: BPHS Ch 3 vv. 16-17 (dark), Phaladeepika Ch 2 v. 14; dark blue: traditional association

favourable.en: Hora of {graha}, a functional benefic for this chart: a supportive hour to begin things.
favourable.hi: {graha} की होरा, जो इस कुंडली में शुभ फल देने वाला ग्रह है: काम शुरू करने के लिए सहायक समय।

avoid.en: Hora of {graha}, a functional malefic for this chart: better for routine work than for new beginnings.
avoid.hi: {graha} की होरा, जो इस कुंडली में अशुभ फल देने वाला ग्रह है: नई शुरुआत के बजाय सामान्य काम के लिए बेहतर।

neutral.en: Hora of {graha}, neutral for this chart.
neutral.hi: {graha} की होरा, इस कुंडली के लिए सम।

colour_today.hi: आज आपके लिए सहायक हो सकने वाला रंग: {colour} ({graha})।

colour_avoid.hi: आज कम प्रयोग करने वाला रंग: {colour} ({graha})।
